from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def components(g,bgv):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if (i,j) in seen or g[i][j]==bgv: continue
            q=[(i,j)]; s={(i,j)}; seen.add((i,j))
            while q:
                r,c=q.pop()
                for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]==g[i][j] and (nr,nc) not in s:
                        s.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc)); seen.add((nr,nc))
            out.append(s)
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    I,O=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bgv=Counter(x for row in I for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=components(I,bgv)
    cnt=Counter(int(x) for row in I for x in row)
    singles=[(r,c,int(I[r][c])) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
              if int(I[r][c])!=bgv and not any((r,c) in s for s in cs if len(s)>=2)]
    multis=[c for c in cs if len(c)>=2]
    print('===',k,'H,W',H,W,'bg',bgv)

    print('   multi comps:',[(min(m),I[min(m)[0]][min(m)[1]],len(m)) for m in multis])
    diff=[(i,j,int(O[i][j]),int(I[i][j])) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if O[i][j]!=I[i][j]]
    # group diffs by nearest singleton marker (within Chebyshev dist<=2 of a new cell; skip template cells)
    tmptset=set(next(iter(m)) for m in multis)
    em=defaultdict(list)
    for (r,c,new,old) in diff:
        if (r,c) in tmptset: continue
        best=None
        for (mr,mc_,mv) in singles:
            d=max(abs(r-mr),abs(c-mc_))
            if d<=2 and (best is None or d<best[0]):
                best=(d,(mr,mc_,mv))
        if best: em[best[1]].append((r-mr[0],c-mc_[1]))
    for mv,mms in sorted(em.items()):

from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def components(g,bgv):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if (i,j) in seen or g[i][j]==bgv: continue
            q=[(i,j)]; s={(i,j)}; seen.add((i,j))
            while q:
                r,c=q.pop()
                for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]==g[i][j] and (nr,nc) not in s:
                        s.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc)); seen.add((nr,nc))
            out.append(s)
    return out

# Test clipping hypothesis: candidate translations where ALL source cells land on background (bgv in input), keep those, pick the one whose image touches marker, verify exact reproduced output.
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bgv=collections.Counter(int(x) for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cc=comps(g,bgv); srcs=[c for c in cc if len(c)>1]; marks=[p for c in cc if len(c)==1 for p in c]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for m in marks:
        sc=int(g[m[0]][m[1]])
        for s in srcs:
            ss=int(g[s[0][0]][s[0][1]])
            if ss==sc: continue
            nsh=norm(s)
            # candidates: translations landing entirely on background cells
            cands=[]
            for dr in range(-H,H+1):
                for dc in range(-W,W+1):
                    t={(rr+dr,cc_+dc) for rr,cc_ in nsh}
                    if any(r<0 or r>=H or c<0 or c>=W or g[r][c]!=bgv for r,c in t): continue
                    ds=min(abs(m[0]-r)+abs(m[1]-c) for r,c in t)
                    cands.append((ds,len(t),t))
            cands.sort()
            best=tuple(cands[0][2]) if cands else None
            for r,c in best:
                if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W: out[r][c]=ss
    return out
